payout_quote: Get $50* for each referral ... When they open a new checking account or loan, we'll give you $50 and they'll receive $100.*
steps: Fill out the online referral form on firstccu.com (or print the coupon and give it to your friend).
Friend opens a new checking account or qualifying loan ($10,000+, no unsecured loans) and submits your referral at account opening.
Friend completes requirements within 60 days (checking: 20 debit transactions + direct deposit required).
catches: Friend must be a new member (no FirstCCU membership account for at least 1 year) and complete real requirements — 20 debit card transactions within 60 days for checking, plus direct deposit; loans must exceed $10,000.
Referral must be submitted at the time of account opening — late submissions don't qualify.
Referrer must be a current member in good standing at payout; incentives paid within 60 days after requirements are satisfied, deposited into membership savings.
No cap stated on official page, but program is subject to change at any time without notice; FirstCCU may disqualify referrals not made in good faith.
Employees and their households are not eligible.
biggest_catch: Your friend has to actually qualify — 20 debit purchases plus direct deposit within 60 days for checking — and the referral must be submitted when they open the account, not after.
eligibility: Current FirstCCU member in good standing (WI/IL credit union); friend must be a new member, 18+, meeting membership eligibility. Employees and household excluded.
timing: Submit form in ~10 minutes; incentive deposited into membership savings within 60 days after the friend satisfies all requirements.

notes: Verified 2026-09-23 via live official FirstCCU (WI/IL) Refer a Friend page. Referrer earns $50 per referral (friend gets $100); no referral-count cap stated on the page.
payout_value_note: $50 paid to referrer per qualified referral (cash deposited into membership savings).
numeric_basis: payout $50 flat per referral from official terms; time: online form or coupon handoff est. 5-15 min active
when_cash_arrives: Submit form in ~10 minutes; incentive deposited into membership savings within 60 days after the friend satisfies all requirements. Terms impose a fixed waiting period after the friend's account opens - nothing arrives before that date.
maximize: Refer early and have your friend complete ALL qualifying activity in the first days of the window - late qualification pushes the fixed payout date even further out.
Both accounts must stay open and in good standing through the entire wait - early closure forfeits the bonus.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the program's terms lock payout to a fixed date (60-120 days out) regardless of how fast your friend qualifies.
